useless

(adjective). Vô dụng

universally

(adjective). Ngoạn mục

sole

(adjective). duy nhất

shift

(verb). phát hành

Ex: They've released a new version of the original film.

property

(noun). Tài sản

Ex: This building is government property.

propel

(verb). thúc đẩy

Ex: The film propelled him to international stardom.

patent

(verb). cấp bằng sáng chế

Ex: The invention has been patented by the university.

over the moon

(phrase). rất vui

Ex: They’re over the moon about their trip to Japan.

(phrase). sự tự do hoàn toàn

Ex: The changes will give developers open slather.

margin

(noun). lợi nhuận, lãi suất

manually

(adverb). bằng tay

Ex: Tickets are checked manually at peak times.

(phrase). có tiến triển

launch

(verb). khởi đầu, bắt đầu

(adjective). Về mặt trí tuệ

(noun). trợ cấp

(verb). nói chung chung

(verb). dự báo, dự đoán

(verb). tăng vọt

Ex: Wages and prices have skyrocketed.

sincerity

(noun). sự chân thật

Ex: She spoke with total sincerity.

scale

(noun). quy mô

Ex: Manufacturing is done on a small scale.

resist

(verb). cưỡng lại

Ex: They are determined to resist pressure to change the law.

relegate

(verb). giao cho

Ex: She was then relegated to the role of assistant.

purchaser

(noun). người mua

Ex: We haven't been able to find a purchaser for our house yet.

prominently

(adverb). dễ thấy, nổi bật

Ex: A photograph of her daughter was prominently displayed on her desk.

previous

(adjective). trước

Ex: No previous experience is necessary for this job.

prescribe

(verb). kê đơn

Ex: He may be able to prescribe you something for that cough.

persist

(verb). Kiên trì

Ex: She persisted in her search for the truth.

patent

(adjective). có bằng sáng chế

Ex: patent medicines Ex: It benefits from a tax-free patent income scheme which allows it to retain earnings.

overdo

(verb). cường điệu hóa

Ex: She really overdid the sympathy

outrageous

(adjective). không chấp nhận được

Ex: She thought it absolutely outrageous that he should be promoted over her.

nourishing

(adjective). bổ dưỡng

Ex: Vegetarian food can be both nourishing and cheap.

mourn

(verb). than khóc, thương tiếc

Ex: The city was mourning the victims of the bombings.

mounting

(adjective). tăng lên

Ex: mounting excitement/concern/tension Ex: There is mounting evidence of serious effects on people's health.

manifest

(adjective). rõ ràng, hiển nhiên

Ex: His nervousness was manifest to all those present.

justice

(noun). công lý

Ex: She spent her life fighting for social justice and equality for women.

invade

(verb). xâm lược, xâm chiếm

Ex: When did the Romans invade Britain?

intense

(adjective). dữ dội

Ex: He suddenly felt an intense pain in his back.

imperial

(adjective). hoàng gia

Ex: The building is a reminder of the country's imperial past.

hysterical

(adjective). kích động

Ex: He became almost hysterical when I told him.

guarantee

(verb). cam kết, đảm bảo

Ex: Basic human rights, including freedom of speech, are now guaranteed.

grip

(noun). sự nắm chặt, sự kiểm soát

Ex: The home team took a firm grip on the game.

grind to a halt

(phrase). dần dừng lại

Ex: Production ground to a halt during the strike.

go down with

(verb). mắc bệnh

Ex: Our youngest boy has gone down with chickenpox.

gloom

(noun). sự ảm đạm, u sầu

Ex: He remained sunk in gloom for several days.

frail

(adjective). Mỏng manh, yếu đuối

Ex: His frail hands were shaking.

few and far between

(phrase). ít thấy

Ex: Apartments that are both comfortable and reasonably priced are few and far between.

fearful

(adjective). lo lắng

Ex: He hesitated before calling her, fearful of what she might say.

expose

(verb). phơi bày ra

Ex: My job as a journalist is to expose the truth.

exploit

(verb). khai thác

Ex: The company has been successful in exploiting new technology to the full.

eminent

(adjective). xuất sắc, lỗi lạc

Ex: The commission consisted of fifteen eminent political figures.

emerge

(verb). xuất hiện

Ex: The swimmer emerged from the lake. Ex: The facts behind the scandal are sure to emerge eventually.

eager

(adjective). háo hức

Ex: Everyone in the class seemed eager to learn.

doom

(noun). sự bất hạnh

Ex: The ordinary soldiers went to meet their doom with great bravery.

disinfect

(verb). khử trùng

Ex: Accommodation rooms were cleaned and disinfected one section at a time, and new guests were accommodated in the cleaned sections

diligently

(adverb). siêng năng, cần cù

Ex: They worked diligently on the task they had been given.

deposit

(verb). ký thác

Ex: Millions were deposited in Swiss bank accounts.

defence

(noun). phòng thủ

Ex: What points can be raised in defence of this argument?

declare

(verb). Tuyên bố

Ex: The government has declared a state of emergency.

cut a swathe through something

(phrase). ảnh hưởng lớn, phá hủy

Ex: Building the tunnel would involve cutting a great swathe through the forest.

concede

(verb). thừa nhận

Ex: He was forced to concede that there might be difficulties.

compelling

(adjective). Đầy tính thu hút, giàu tính thuyết phuc

Ex: Her latest book makes compelling reading.

cemetery

(noun). nghĩa trang

Ex: He was buried in a private cemetery.

aristocrat

(noun). quý tộc

Ex: Many aristocrats were killed in the French Revolution.

appeal

(verb). kháng cáo

Ex: He said he would appeal after being found guilty on four counts of murder.

annual

(adjective). hàng năm

Ex: The 12th annual Music Festival runs from Friday 25th to Monday 28th October.

wave

(noun). làn sóng

Ex: A wave of panic spread through the crowd.

sweep

(verb). quét qua

Ex: The rebellion had swept through all four of the country's provinces.

succumb

(verb). chịu thua

Ex: She succumbed to the temptation of another drink.

rural

(adjective). Thuộc khu vực miền quê

Ex: He grew up in a predominantly rural area.

lethal

(adjective). gây chết người

Ex: The snake’s venom is rarely lethal to humans.

affect

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: Your opinion will not affect my decision.

flu

(noun). bệnh cúm

Ex: He is suffering from flu-like symptoms.

theory

(noun). Giả thuyết; học thuyết

Ex: He has a theory that the hole was caused by a meteorite.

organism

(noun). cơ thể, sinh vật

Ex: The cell is the unit of which all living organisms are composed.

identify

(verb). Xác định, nhận dạng

Ex: They are trying to identify what is wrong with the present system.

gain ground

(phrase). trở nên thành công

Ex: The Republicans are gaining ground in the southern states.

germ

(noun). mầm bệnh, vi trùng

Ex: Dirty hands can be a breeding ground for germs.

cling to

(verb). bám lấy

Ex: Throughout the trial she had clung to the belief that he was innocent.

absence

(noun). Sự vắng mặt

Ex: We did not receive any news during his long absence.

prescription

(noun). đơn thuốc

Ex: Then I went to attend to my patients and wrote prescriptions and directions for their ailments.

ingredient

(noun). Thành phần, nguyên liệu

Ex: Our skin cream contains only natural ingredients.

incessant

(adjective). không ngừng, không dứt, liên miên

Ex: There was the incessant traffic noise in narrow streets.

fever

(noun). sốt

Ex: He's got a headache and a slight fever.

ease

(verb). làm dịu

Ex: These pills should ease the pain.

contain

(verb). Chứa đựng, bao gồm

Ex: This drink doesn't contain any alcohol.

nozzle

(noun). miệng, vòi (ấm)

Ex: An inert gas then propels the liquid through an ultrasonic nozzle that atomizes it.

hollow

(adjective). trống rỗng

Ex: I tapped the tin and it sounded hollow.

gauze

(noun). gạc

Ex: He wrapped the test tube in a roll of cotton gauze and placed it in his bag.

cover

(verb). bao phủ

Ex: Snow covered the ground.

treat

(verb). xử lí

Ex: You need to treat this wood for woodworm.

powder

(noun). Bột, hạt mịn

Ex: You'll get more flavour from the spices if you grind them into a powder.

locate

(verb). đặt vào vị trí

Ex: They located their headquarters in Swindon.

content

(noun). nội dung

Ex: She hadn't read the letter and so was unaware of its contents.

sue

(verb). kiện

Ex: They threatened to sue if the work was not completed.

recover

(verb). hồi phục

Ex: He has fully recovered from the shoulder surgery.

legal

(adjective). thuộc về pháp luật

Ex: They are currently facing a long legal battle in the US courts.

initiate

(verb). bắt đầu, khởi xướng

Ex: Many of them had been initiated into drug use at an early age.

respond

(verb). phản hồi

Ex: She never responded to my letter.

reply

(noun). lời phản hồi, lời hồi đáp

Ex: I asked her what her name was but she made no reply.

complaint

(noun). Lời phàn nàn

Ex: I'd like to make a complaint about the noise.

wise

(adjective). thông thái, khôn ngoan

Ex: He was wise to consider his future when he was working there.

weak

(adjective). yếu

Ex: That bridge is too weak for heavy traffic.

thoughtful

(adjective). có suy nghĩ, sâu sắc

Ex: He has a thoughtful approach to his work.

describe

(verb). miêu tả

Ex: Can you describe him to me?

credulous

(adjective). cả tin, nhẹ dạ

Ex: Few people are credulous enough to believe such nonsense.

audience

(noun). Khán giả

Ex: The museum is trying to attract a wider audience.

aim

(verb). nhắm vào, hướng vào

Ex: The government is aiming at a 50% reduction in unemployment.

advert

(noun). mẩu quảng cáo

Ex: I put an advert in the local newspaper.

treat

(verb). đối xử

Ex: My parents still treat me like a child.

pronounce

(verb). tuyên bố

Ex: He pronounced the country to be in a state of war.

extravagance

(noun). sự phung phí

Ex: Such extravagance is shameful when there are people starving in the world.

bind

(verb). trói buộc

Ex: The agreement binds her to repay the debt within six months.

contract

(noun). hợp đồng

Ex: All employees have a written contract of employment.

validity

(noun). sự có căn cứ

Ex: We had doubts about the validity of their argument.

unilateral

(adjective). đơn phương

Ex: More than 70 developing countries have undertaken unilateral trade liberalization initiatives during the last 20 years.

remedy

(noun). Phương thuốc; Cách giải quyết

Ex: There is no simple remedy for unemployment.

principle

(noun). Nguyên tắc

Ex: She went on to explain the principles behind what she was doing.

fraud

(noun). lừa đảo

Ex: It was said that the property had been obtained by fraud.

establish

(verb). Thiết lập

Ex: Let’s establish some ground rules.

constitute

(verb). Cấu tạo nên

Ex: Female workers constitute the majority of the labour force.

cite

(verb). biểu dương, trích dẫn

Ex: He cited personal reasons for his decision to resign.

sections.title: Passage 3: Communicating styles and conflict
sections.html:
accomplish

(verb). đạt được

Ex: The first part of the plan has been safely accomplished.

achieve

(verb). Đạt được, giành được

Ex: He had finally achieved success.

approach

(verb). tiếp cận

Ex: He approached the task in a very mature and systematic way.

appropriate

(adjective). Phù hợp

Ex: Is now an appropriate time to make a speech?

detriment

(noun). sự gây tổn hại

Ex: Too many tests are a detriment to good education.

dominate

(verb). Thống trị

Ex: The train crash dominated the news.

enthusiasm

(noun). sự hào hứng, sự hăng hái

Ex: The news was greeted with a lack of enthusiasm by those at the meeting.

handle

(verb). giải quyết

Ex: A new man was appointed to handle the crisis.

illustrate

(verb). Minh hoạ

Ex: He is showing these silent films to help illustrate his story of survival.

incentive

(noun). Động lực

Ex: There is no incentive for people to save fuel.

invigorating

(adjective). tiếp thêm sinh lực

Ex: These yoga postures are invigorating and good for balance.

persevering

(adjective). kiên trì, bền bì

Ex: A few persevering climbers finally reached the top.

perspective

(noun). Góc nhìn

Ex: A historical perspective may help us understand the issue.

proper

(adjective). đúng cách, phù hợp

Ex: We should have had a proper discussion before voting.

influence

(noun). ảnh hưởng

Ex: His early work shows the influence of Cézanne and Matisse.

relate

(verb). liên quan

Ex: We shall discuss the problem as it relates to our specific case.

temperament

(noun). tính cách

Ex: She's a dreamer and a romantic by temperament.

assessment

(noun). đánh giá, định giá

Ex: The city hired them to do a structural assessment of the damage.

characterize

(verb). biểu thị đặc biệt

Ex: How would you characterize the mood of the 1990s?

aspect

(noun). Khía cạnh

Ex: The book aims to cover all aspects of city life.

greet

(verb). chào hỏi

Ex: He greeted all the guests warmly as they arrived.

intend

(verb). Dự định

Ex: The train we had intended to catch had already left.

occur

(verb). xảy ra

Ex: Three major events occurred in my life that year.

rarely

(adverb). hiếm

Ex: The term is rarely used today.

realize

(verb). nhận ra

Ex: They didn't realize the danger they were in.

value

(noun). giá trị

Ex: For them, the house's main value lay in its quiet country location.

determine

(verb). Quyết định

Ex: Upbringing plays an important part in determining a person's character.

conflict

(noun). Xung đột

Ex: The violence was the result of political and ethnic conflicts.

focus

(verb). tập trung

Ex: She was distracted and finding it hard to focus.

resolve

(verb). giải quyết

Ex: Attempts are being made to resolve the problem of security in schools.

apt

(adjective). thích hợp

Ex: The song would have been more apt for a bass voice.

description

(noun). Sự miêu tả, sự mô tả

Ex: The name means ‘no trees’ and it is an accurate description of the island.

summarise

(verb). tóm tắt

Ex: I'll just summarize the main points of the argument in a few words.

concerned

(adjective). bận tâm, lo lắng

Ex: The president is deeply concerned about this issue.

discussion

(noun). sự bàn luận

Ex: I discovered something interesting during a family discussion.

engage

(verb). tham gia vào

Ex: The army was regularly engaged in combat.

invest

(verb). đầu tư

Ex: She advised us to invest in the property market.

sidetrack

(verb). làm xao nhãng

Ex: I was supposed to be writing a letter but I'm afraid I got sidetracked.

adventure

(noun). Phiêu lưu

Ex: When you're a child, life is one big adventure.

sanguine

(adjective). lạc quan, đầy hi vọng

Ex: They are less sanguine about the company's long-term prospects.

overwhelm

(verb). áp đảo, lấn át

Ex: The wave broke through the wall and overwhelmed the town.

systematic

(adjective). Có hệ thống

Ex: None of the studies were sufficiently systematic to give a reliable result.

adapt

(verb). Thích nghi

Ex: The organisms were forced to adapt in order to survive.

phlegmatic

(adjective). bình tĩnh, thản nhiên

Ex: As a football player, his great asset was his calm, phlegmatic manner.

considerate

(adjective). chu đáo, ân cần

Ex: Louis was a kind, caring and considerate young man.

distract

(verb). Đánh lạc hướng, gây mất tập trung

Ex: You're distracting me from my work.

melancholic

(adjective). u sầu

Ex: melancholic songs Ex: The night was as melancholic as his mood.

orient

(verb). định hướng

Ex: ​Our students are oriented towards science subjects.

solicit

(verb). thu hút

Ex: Volunteers are being solicited to assist with the project.

sympathetic

(adjective). cảm thông

Ex: She was very sympathetic when I was sick.

status quo

(noun). hiện trạng

Ex: They wanted a return to the status quo before the war.

threaten

(verb). đe dọa

Ex: Pollution is threatening marine life.

bold

(adjective). Mạnh dạn

Ex: The wine made him bold enough to approach her.

brief

(adjective). Ngắn gọn

Ex: Could you make it brief? I've got a meeting in ten minutes.

choleric

(adjective). nóng tính

Ex: He was a choleric, self-important little man.

direct

(adjective). trực diện, trực tiếp

Ex: You'll have to get used to his direct manner.

forceful

(adjective). mạnh mẽ

Ex: His mother was a forceful character and had a big influence on him.

intimidating

(adjective). đáng sợ

Ex: The atmosphere was less intimidating than I had imagined.

outcome

(noun). Kết quả

Ex: We are confident of a positive outcome.

thrive

(verb). Phát triển mạnh

Ex: New businesses thrive in this area.

underestimate

(verb). đánh giá thấp

Ex: We underestimated the time it would take to get there.

context

(noun). Bối cảnh

Ex: Such databases are being used in a wide range of contexts.

dominant

(adjective). ưu thế

Ex: The firm has achieved a dominant position in the world market.

evident

(adjective). Hiển nhiên

Ex: It has now become evident to us that a mistake has been made.

flexibility

(noun). Tính linh hoạt

Ex: The new system offers a much greater degree of flexibility in the way work is organized.

identify

(verb). Xác định, nhận dạng

Ex: They are trying to identify what is wrong with the present system.

relevant

(adjective). Có liên quan

Ex: These comments are not directly relevant to this inquiry.

influence

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: His film is heavily influenced by other film-makers.

constantly

(adverb). một cách liên tục

Ex: Fashion is constantly changing.

variety

(noun). Sự đa dạng

Ex: This tool can be used in a variety of ways.

tend

(verb). có xu hướng

Ex: People tend to be happier if they are in a long-term relationship.

uneasy

(adjective). lo lắng, không yên

Ex: She had an uneasy feeling that something terrible was going to happen.

according to

(preposition). theo

Ex: The salary will be fixed according to qualifications and experience.

employee

(noun). người làm công

Ex: The firm has over 500 employees.

manager

(noun). người quản lí

Ex: I'm a senior manager in a multinational compan

select

(verb). chọn lọc

Ex: He hasn't been selected for the team.

possible

(adjective). có thể

Ex: It is possible to get there by bus.

affect

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: Your opinion will not affect my decision.

effective

(adjective). Có hiệu quả

Ex: Aspirin is a simple but highly effective treatment.

predominance

(noun). tính trội, ưu thé

Ex: A survey of judges showed the overwhelming predominance of upper-class backgrounds.

reflect

(verb). phản ánh, cho thấy bản chất của

Ex: Our newspaper aims to reflect the views of the local community.

require

(verb). cần, yêu cầu

Ex: These pets require a lot of care and attention.

workplace

(noun). nơi làm việc

Ex: These safety standards apply to all workplaces.

colleague

(noun). Đồng nghiệp

Ex: We were friends and colleagues for more than 20 years.

interpersonal

(adjective). giữa cá nhân với nhau

Ex: The successful applicant will have excellent interpersonal skills.
